generate_proposals_from_pairwise_affinit: generate segmentation proposals and scores from a pairwise affinity tensor using potential2masks and ranking
compute_iou_between_masks: compute the IoU between two binary mask arrays or torch tensors with an optional threshold
rank_masks_by_color_variance: rank segmentation masks by color variance in an image with optional NMS filtering
evaluate_coco_protocol: evaluate detection results using the COCO evaluation protocol with optional category filtering
rank_proposals_by_potential: rank segmentation proposals by boundary potential scores with NMS and edge filtering
